title: Brazilian Cherry Bake
description: A sweet and gooey dessert featuring cherry and bake flavors.
instructions: Mix together the bake flour, ultra sugar, and gooey butter.
Add the brazilian cherry jam and mix until a dough forms.
Beat in the eggs and add salt to taste.
Pour the mixture into a greased 20cm (8-inch) round cake tin.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the tin for 10 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
